examples.chinese: 我家有一隻貓、兩隻狗和三隻鳥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī māo, liǎng zhī gǒu hé sān zhī niǎo.
examples.english: I have a cat, two dogs, and three birds in my house.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

examples.chinese: 因為天氣太熱了，有一隻貓在車子底下休息，不肯離開。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì tài rè le, yǒu yì zhī māo zài chēzi dǐxià xiūxi, bù kěn líkāi.
examples.english: Because the weather is too hot, a cat is resting under the car and refuses to leave.

examples.chinese: A:醫生，我求你快救救我的貓。 B:別急！我馬上檢查。
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng, wǒ qiú nǐ kuài jiùjiu wǒ de māo. B: Bié jí! Wǒ mǎshàng jiǎnchá.
examples.english: A: Doctor, I beg you to save my cat quickly. B: Don't worry! I'll examine it right away.

examples.chinese: 越南也有十二生肖，可是我們沒有兔年，有貓年。我是貓年出生的，屬貓。
examples.pinyin: Yuènán yě yǒu shí'èr shēngxiào, kěshì wǒmen méi yǒu tù nián, yǒu māo nián. Wǒ shì māo nián chūshēng de, shǔ māo.
examples.english: There are also zodiac signs in Vietnam, but we don’t have the year of the Rabbit; we have the year of the Cat. I was born in the year of the Cat, which means my zodiac animal sign is cat.

examples.chinese: 我覺得當記者不容易，週末常常不能休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dāng jìzhě bù róngyì, zhōumò chángcháng bù néng xiūxí.
examples.english: I think being a reporter is not easy; often I can't rest on weekends.

examples.chinese: 記者說參加這次慢跑活動的人數已經超過了一百人，可是我數來數去只有五十幾個。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě shuō cānjiā zhè cì mànpǎo huódòng de rénshù yǐjīng chāoguò le yìbǎi rén, kěshì wǒ shǔ lái shǔ qù zhǐyǒu wǔshí jǐ ge.
examples.english: The reporter said the number of people participating in this jogging event has already exceeded one hundred, but I counted and counted and there were only fifty-some.

examples.chinese:
那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。
總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin:
Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá.
Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english:
That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather.
Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese:
歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。
那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
examples.pinyin:
Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng.
Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.
examples.english:
Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous.
That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

examples.chinese: 這位記者專門報導社會新聞，他報新聞的方式相當專業。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jìzhě zhuānmén bàodǎo shèhuì xīnwén, tā bào xīnwén de fāngshì xiāngdāng zhuānyè.
examples.english: This reporter specializes in reporting social news; the way he reports news is quite professional.

items.wordHook: 記(record) + 者(person) → the person who records events: 記者 is a reporter.

examples.chinese: 到國外生活以前，得先找租房子的資料。山本良介覺得在台灣生活的費用(生活費)不太高，日本的比較高。
examples.pinyin: Dào guówài shēnghuó yǐqián, děi xiān zhǎo zū fángzi de zīliào. Shānběn Liángjiè juéde zài Táiwān shēnghuó de fèiyòng (shēnghuófèi) bù tài gāo, Rìběn de bǐjiào gāo.
examples.english: Before going abroad to live, you must first find information about renting a place. Yamamoto Ryosuke feels that the cost of living in Taiwan is not very high; Japan's is higher.

examples.chinese: 在外國跟在自己國家的生活一定不太一樣。
examples.pinyin: Zài wàiguó gēn zài zìjǐ guójiā de shēnghuó yídìng bú tài yíyàng.
examples.english: Living in a foreign country and living in your own country are definitely not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 我在台灣的生活不錯，很喜歡這裡，也有很多好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiwān de shēnghuó búcuò, hěn xǐhuan zhèlǐ, yě yǒu hěn duō hǎo péngyou.
examples.english: My life in Taiwan is good; I like it here a lot, and I also have many good friends.

examples.chinese: 請你想像一下，二十年以後，你的生活會怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ xiǎngxiàng yíxià, èrshí nián yǐhòu, nǐ de shēnghuó huì zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Please imagine: twenty years from now, what will your life be like?

examples.chinese: 上中文課時，老師要我們用中文報告在台灣的生活。
examples.pinyin: Shàng Zhōngwén kè shí, lǎoshī yào wǒmen yòng Zhōngwén bàogào zài Táiwān de shēnghuó.
examples.english: In Chinese class, the teacher wants us to report in Chinese on our life in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 那個老人年紀太大，沒辦法一個人生活。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎorén niánjì tài dà, méi bànfǎ yīgè rén shēnghuó.
examples.english: That old man is too old; he has no way to live by himself.

examples.chinese: 我的家人非常關心我在國外的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jiārén fēicháng guānxīn wǒ zài guówài de shēnghuó.
examples.english: My family is very concerned about my life abroad.

examples.chinese: 很多大學生都打過工，因為得自己付生活費。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuéshēng dōu dǎ guò gōng, yīnwèi děi zìjǐ fù shēnghuófèi.
examples.english: Many university students have had part-time jobs because they have to pay their own living expenses.

examples.chinese: 因為科技越來越進步了，所以生活也變得更便利了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi kējì yuè lái yuè jìnbù le, suǒyǐ shēnghuó yě biàn de gèng biànlì le.
examples.english: Because technology is becoming more and more advanced, life has also become more convenient.

examples.chinese: 沒有人會永遠活著，所以我們每天都要開開心心地生活。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén huì yǒngyuǎn huózhe, suǒyǐ wǒmen měi tiān dōu yào kāikāixīnxīn de shēnghuó.
examples.english: No one can live forever, so we should live happily every day.

examples.chinese: 我的理想是找到一份正式的工作，過幸福的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de lǐxiǎng shì zhǎodào yí fèn zhèngshì de gōngzuò, guò xìngfú de shēnghuó.
examples.english: My ideal is to find a formal job and live a happy life.

examples.chinese: 為了給孩子幸福的生活，很多父母一輩子都努力地工作。王先生這輩子沒結婚，他希望下輩子會有機會。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gěi háizi xìngfú de shēnghuó, hěn duō fùmǔ yíbèizi dōu nǔlì de gōngzuò. Wáng xiānsheng zhè bèizi méi jiéhūn, tā xīwàng xià bèizi huì yǒu jīhuì.
examples.english: In order to give their children a happy life, many parents work hard their whole life. Mr. Wang hasn't married in this lifetime; he hopes he will have a chance in the next life.

examples.chinese: 我室友的生活習慣很差，我已經忍耐他很久了，真希望他馬上搬走。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shìyǒu de shēnghuó xíguàn hěn chà, wǒ yǐjīng rěnnài tā hěn jiǔ le, zhēn xīwàng tā mǎshàng bān zǒu.
examples.english: My roommate's living habits are very bad; I have tolerated him for a long time, and I really hope he moves out immediately.

examples.chinese: 在我爺爺奶奶的年代，生活比較辛苦，不少窮人為了省錢，衣服破了還是繼續穿。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ yéye nǎinai de niándài, shēnghuó bǐjiào xīnkǔ, bùshǎo qióngrén wèile shěng qián, yīfu pò le háishì jìxù chuān.
examples.english: In my grandparents' era, life was relatively hard; many poor people, in order to save money, continued to wear clothes even after they were torn.

examples.chinese: 這個社區的周圍有山有水，空氣也很好，這樣的生活環境很適合退休的人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shèqū de zhōuwéi yǒu shān yǒu shuǐ, kōngqì yě hěn hǎo, zhèyàng de shēnghuó huánjìng hěn shìhé tuìxiū de rén.
examples.english: The neighborhood of this community has mountains and water, and the air is also very good; such a living environment is very suitable for retired people.

examples.chinese: 孔先生很重視生活品質，也很喜歡做家事，所以總是把家裡整理得乾乾淨淨的。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānshēng hěn zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí, yě hěn xǐhuān zuò jiāshì, suǒyǐ zǒngshì bǎ jiālǐ zhěnglǐ de gāngānjìngjìng de.
examples.english: Mr. Kong values quality of life very much and also likes doing housework, so he always organizes his home until it is clean and tidy.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese: 市場為了改善兒童和青少年的生活品質，而增加了球場、游泳池等休閒場所。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng wèile gǎishàn értóng hé qīngshàonián de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, ér zēngjiā le qiúchǎng, yóuyǒngchí děng xiūxián chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: In order to improve the quality of life for children and teenagers, the market added leisure places such as ball courts and swimming pools.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài dà mǎlù páng, cóng zǎo dào wǎn zàoyīn bùduàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng le shēnghuó pǐnzhí, suǒyǐ juédìng bānjiā.
examples.english: My home is next to a major road, and there is constant noise from morning till night, which has seriously affected our quality of life, so we decided to move.

examples.chinese: 他參加了服務社團的活動後，生活比過去更豐富、更有意義。
examples.pinyin: Tā cānjiā le fúwù shètuán de huódòng hòu, shēnghuó bǐ guòqù gèng fēngfù, gèng yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: After he participated in the service club's activities, his life has become richer and more meaningful than in the past.

examples.chinese: 這個地區不僅沒有地震、颱風，而且天氣好、空氣新鮮，生活環境安全又舒適。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bùjǐn méiyǒu dìzhèn, táifēng, érqiě tiānqì hǎo, kōngqì xīnxiān, shēnghuó huánjìng ānquán yòu shūshì.
examples.english: This area not only has no earthquakes or typhoons, but also has good weather and fresh air; the living environment is safe and comfortable.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 當人們生活水準提高，開始重視生活品質時，休閒活動也就跟著多了起來。
examples.pinyin: Dāng rénmen shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn tígāo, kāishǐ zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí shí, xiūxián huódòng yě jiù gēnzhe duō le qǐlái.
examples.english: When people's standard of living rises and they begin to value quality of life, leisure activities then increase accordingly.

examples.chinese: 李小姐結婚以後的生活重心就是家庭，尤其是照顧剛出生的小孩。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě jiéhūn yǐhòu de shēnghuó zhòngxīn jiùshì jiātíng, yóuqí shì zhàogù gāng chūshēng de xiǎohái.
examples.english: After Miss Li got married, the focus of her life is her family, especially taking care of her newborn child.

examples.chinese: 市長解決了不少這個城市的生活問題，因此民眾的生活水準也大大提高了。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng jiějué le bùshǎo zhège chéngshì de shēnghuó wèntí, yīncǐ mínzhòng de shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě dàdà tígāo le.
examples.english: The mayor solved quite a few of this city's living problems, therefore the people's standard of living has also greatly improved.

examples.chinese: 我覺得減少工作，增加有意義的休閒活動，這樣的生活比較充實。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde jiǎnshǎo gōngzuò, zēngjiā yǒu yìyì de xiūxián huódòng, zhèyàng de shēnghuó bǐjiào chōngshí.
examples.english: I think reducing work and increasing meaningful leisure activities—this kind of life is more fulfilling.

examples.chinese:
陳先生有五個孩子，生活費負擔很大。
小張不想增加父親的負擔，為了負擔自己的學費，一下課就去打工。
examples.pinyin:
Chén xiānsheng yǒu wǔ gè háizi, shēnghuófèi fùdān hěn dà.
Xiǎo Zhāng bù xiǎng zēngjiā fùqīn de fùdān, wèile fùdān zìjǐ de xuéfèi, yī xiàkè jiù qù dǎgōng.
examples.english:
Mr. Chen has five children, so the burden of living expenses is very great.
Little Zhang doesn't want to increase his father's burden; in order to shoulder his own tuition, he goes to work as soon as class is over.

examples.chinese: 小連跟老闆吵架而離開了公司，為了讓家人能繼續過安定的生活，他正努力地找新工作。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lián gēn lǎobǎn chǎojià ér líkāi le gōngsī, wèile ràng jiārén néng jìxù guò āndìng de shēnghuó, tā zhèng nǔlì de zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Xiao Lian left the company after quarreling with the boss; in order to let his family continue to live a safe and stable life, he is working hard to find a new job.

examples.chinese: 正常的生活作息，對身體和心理健康都很重要。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngcháng de shēnghuó zuòxī, duì shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ jiànkāng dōu hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: A normal daily schedule is very important for both physical and mental health.

examples.chinese: 透過社群網站，我們可以加入感興趣的社團，讓自己的生活更充實。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, wǒmen kěyǐ jiārù gǎn xìngqù de shètuán, ràng zìjǐ de shēnghuó gèng chōngshí.
examples.english: Through social media, we can join clubs we are interested in, making our lives more fulfilling.

examples.chinese:
現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。
這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin:
Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì.
Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english:
Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient.
This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 人人都希望自己的孩子有幸福的生活、美好的未來。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu xīwàng zìjǐ de háizi yǒu xìngfú de shēnghuó, měihǎo de wèilái.
examples.english: Everyone hopes their children will have a happy life and a beautiful future.

examples.chinese: 何先生早就習慣了單身生活，一點都不想結婚。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiānsheng zǎo jiù xíguàn le dānshēn shēnghuó, yīdiǎn dōu bù xiǎng jiéhūn.
examples.english: Mr. He has long been accustomed to single life and doesn't want to get married at all.

examples.chinese: 人人都渴望浪漫的愛情和幸福的家庭，不過自由自在的單身生活也是不錯的。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu kěwàng làngmàn de àiqíng hé xìngfú de jiātíng, búguò zìyóuzìzài de dānshēn shēnghuó yě shì búcuò de.
examples.english: Everyone longs for romantic love and a happy family, but a free and easy single life is also not bad.

examples.chinese: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 那個美國人每天看臺灣的連續劇，一方面學習中文，一方面了解臺灣的生活文化。
examples.pinyin: Nàge Měiguórén měitiān kàn Táiwān de liánxùjù, yìfāngmiàn xuéxí Zhōngwén, yìfāngmiàn liǎojiě Táiwān de shēnghuó wénhuà.
examples.english: That American watches Taiwanese TV series every day: on one hand to learn Chinese, on the other hand to understand Taiwanese life and culture.

examples.chinese:
外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。
那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin:
Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù.
Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english:
During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance.
That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: 人的一生只有短短幾十年，應該把握時間，讓生活過得充實、 快樂。
examples.pinyin: Rén de yìshēng zhǐyǒu duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yīnggāi bǎwò shíjiān, ràng shēnghuó guò de chōngshí, kuàilè.
examples.english: A person's whole life is only a short few decades; one should grasp time and make life fulfilling and happy.

examples.chinese: 這座城市不但交通十分便利，生活水準也很高，大家都想搬來這裡住。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì bùdàn jiāotōng shífēn biànlì, shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě hěn gāo, dàjiā dōu xiǎng bān lái zhèlǐ zhù.
examples.english: Not only is transportation in this city extremely convenient, but the standard of living is also very high; everyone wants to move here to live.

examples.chinese: 要維持社區良好的生活品質，就要從不亂丟垃圾、減少家庭噪音做起。
examples.pinyin: Yào wéichí shèqū liánghǎo de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, jiù yào cóng bù luàn diū lèsè, jiǎnshǎo jiātíng zàoyīn zuò qǐ.
examples.english: To maintain a good quality of life in the community, we must start by not littering and reducing household noise.

examples.chinese: 人口增加不僅影響生活品質，恐怕也會造成食物缺乏的問題。
examples.pinyin: Rénkǒu zēngjiā bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng shēnghuó pǐnzhí, kǒngpà yě huì zàochéng shíwù quēfá de wèntí.
examples.english: Population growth not only affects the quality of life, but I am afraid it will also cause the problem of food shortage.

examples.chinese:
科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。
網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin:
Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí.
Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english:
Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life.
The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
examples.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
examples.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

examples.chinese: 他這幾年因為投資生意發了，婚姻生活也很幸福，運氣非常好。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè jǐ nián yīnwèi tóuzī shēngyì fā le, hūnyīn shēnghuó yě hěn xìngfú, yùnqì fēicháng hǎo.
examples.english: In recent years he has become wealthy from investing in business, his married life is also very happy, and his luck is extremely good.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: 我們無法決定生命的長度，卻能夠決定生活的品質。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ juédìng shēngmìng de chángdù, què nénggòu juédìng shēnghuó de pǐnzhì.
examples.english: We cannot decide the length of life, but we can decide the quality of life.

examples.chinese: 他愛亂花錢，三天下來，就把一個月的生活費花光了。
examples.pinyin: Tā ài luàn huā qián, sān tiān xiàlái, jiù bǎ yí ge yuè de shēnghuófèi huā guāng le.
examples.english: He loves to spend money recklessly; over three days, he spent his whole month's living expenses.

examples.chinese: 他昨天在酒吧的花費，比我一個月的生活費還高。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuótiān zài jiǔbā de huāfèi, bǐ wǒ yí ge yuè de shēnghuófèi hái gāo.
examples.english: His expenses at the bar yesterday were even higher than my living expenses for a month.

examples.chinese: 每個時代都有自己的價值標準，社會習俗及生活規矩也常隨著時代改變。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge shídài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jiàzhí biāozhǔn, shèhuì xísú jí shēnghuó guījǔ yě cháng suízhe shídài gǎibiàn.
examples.english: Every era has its own value standards, and social customs and life rules also often change with the times.

examples.chinese: 人類破壞了自然，就是破壞了自己的生活環境。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi pòhuài le zìrán, jiù shì pòhuài le zìjǐ de shēnghuó huánjìng.
examples.english: When humans destroy nature, they are destroying their own living environment.

examples.chinese: 從前有很多生活用具都是用銅做的，像銅杯、銅碗什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Cóngqián yǒu hěn duō shēnghuó yòngjù dōu shì yòng tóng zuò de, xiàng tóng bēi, tóng wǎn shénme de.
examples.english: In the past, many household items were made of copper, like copper cups, copper bowls, and so on.

examples.chinese: 每次當我回憶起大學的社團生活，就會想到那一群知心好友。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dāng wǒ huíyì qǐ dàxué de shètuán shēnghuó, jiù huì xiǎngdào nà yī qún zhīxīn hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: Every time I recall my university club life, I think of that group of close friends.

examples.chinese: 為了更有效地利用地球資源，我寧願減少不必要的生活享受。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gèng yǒuxiào de lìyòng dìqiú zīyuán, wǒ nìngyuàn jiǎnshǎo bù bìyào de shēnghuó xiǎngshòu.
examples.english: In order to use Earth's resources more effectively, I would rather reduce unnecessary life pleasures.

examples.chinese: 網路直播的內容各種各樣，甚至有人因為直播平日生活而變成明星。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhíbō de nèiróng gèzhǒng-gèyàng, shènzhì yǒu rén yīnwèi zhíbō píngrì shēnghuó ér biànchéng míngxīng.
examples.english: The content of live internet broadcasts is all kinds of things; some people even become stars because they live-broadcast their everyday life.

examples.chinese: 鄉村生活雖然不如都市那樣方便，但風景美多了。
examples.pinyin: Xiāngcūn shēnghuó suīrán bùrú dūshì nàyàng fāngbiàn, dàn fēngjǐng měi duō le.
examples.english: Although countryside life is not as convenient as the city, the scenery is much more beautiful.

examples.chinese: 生活忙碌的時候，也要給自己留一些休息時間。
examples.pinyin: Shēnghuó mánglù de shíhou, yě yào gěi zìjǐ liú yīxiē xiūxi shíjiān.
examples.english: When life is busy, you should still leave yourself some time to rest.

examples.chinese: 有人一天到晚總看著手機，連錯過了精彩的生活時刻也不知道。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yìtiāndàowǎn zǒng kànzhe shǒujī, lián cuòguòle jīngcǎi de shēnghuó shíkè yě bù zhīdào.
examples.english: Some people always look at their phones from morning till night, and don't even know when they've missed wonderful moments in life.

examples.chinese: A:你說自己沒有想做的事，難道你沒有夢想嗎？ B:我只想簡單過生活，再說，沒有夢想難道不行嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō zìjǐ méiyǒu xiǎng zuò de shì, nándào nǐ méiyǒu mèngxiǎng ma? B: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng jiǎndān guò shēnghuó, zàishuō, méiyǒu mèngxiǎng nándào bùxíng ma?
examples.english: A: You say you have nothing you want to do—don't you have dreams? B: I just want to live a simple life; besides, is it not okay to have no dreams?

examples.chinese: 每年安排一段時間去旅行，說不定能帶給你更豐富的生活。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián ānpái yī duàn shíjiān qù lǚxíng, shuōbudìng néng dài gěi nǐ gèng fēngfù de shēnghuó.
examples.english: If you arrange a period of time to travel every year, it might bring you a richer life.

examples.chinese: 如果真心愛對方，就不必在乎對方的樣子與生活背景。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhēnxīn ài duìfāng, jiù búbì zàihu duìfāng de yàngzi yǔ shēnghuó bèijǐng.
examples.english: If you truly love the other person, you don't need to care about their appearance and background.

examples.chinese: 經過兩段不幸的感情生活，那位女士對愛情已失去了信心。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò liǎng duàn bùxìng de gǎnqíng shēnghuó, nà wèi nǚshì duì àiqíng yǐ shīqù le xìnxīn.
examples.english: After two unfortunate romantic relationships, that lady has already lost confidence in love.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了嚴重的流行病，使人民受到相當大的生活壓力。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le yánzhòng de liúxíngbìng, shǐ rénmín shòudào xiāngdāng dà de shēnghuó yālì.
examples.english: A serious epidemic broke out in the Asian region, causing people to receive considerable life pressure.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了戰爭，使人民生活上所受的的壓力相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le zhànzhēng, shǐ rénmín shēnghuó shàng suǒ shòu de yālì xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: War broke out in the Asian region, causing the pressure that people received in life to be considerable.

examples.chinese: 總統到地震災區慰問災民，並保證會協助他們恢復正常的生活。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng dào dìzhèn zāiqū wèiwèn zāimín, bìng bǎozhèng huì xiézhù tāmen huīfù zhèngcháng de shēnghuó.
examples.english: The president went to the earthquake disaster area to express sympathy and solicitude for the victims, and promised to help them restore a normal life.

examples.chinese: 不管未婚或者已婚的人，在現實生活中都有需要面對的問題。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn wèihūn huòzhě yǐhūn de rén, zài xiànshí shēnghuó zhōng dōu yǒu xūyào miànduì de wèntí.
examples.english: Whether unmarried or married, people all have problems they need to face in real life.

examples.chinese: 李媽媽把寶寶每天的生活都記錄下來，寫成一篇篇的日記。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ māma bǎ bǎobǎo měi tiān de shēnghuó dōu jìlù xiàlái, xiěchéng yī piān piān de rìjì.
examples.english: Mrs. Li recorded the baby's daily life, writing it into diary entries one after another.

examples.chinese: 就算擁有高收入，也不見得能讓你過著幸福美好的生活。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn yōngyǒu gāo shōurù, yě bújiàndé néng ràng nǐ guòzhe xìngfú měihǎo de shēnghuó.
examples.english: Even if you have a high income, it does not necessarily mean you can live a happy and wonderful life.

examples.chinese: 他因為生活條件的限制，而放棄了出國留學的機會。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi shēnghuó tiáojiàn de xiànzhì, ér fàngqì le chūguó liúxué de jīhuì.
examples.english: Due to limitations in his living conditions, he gave up the opportunity to study abroad.

examples.chinese: 隨著電子產業發展，人們的生活習慣也受到很深的影響。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe diànzǐ chǎnyè fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó xíguàn yě shòudào hěn shēn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: With the development of the electronics industry, people's living habits have also been deeply affected.

examples.chinese: 我們週末常去鄉下走走，享受農村生活，黃昏時才回市區。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò cháng qù xiāngxià zǒuzou, xiǎngshòu nóngcūn shēnghuó, huánghūn shí cái huí shìqū.
examples.english: We often go to the countryside on weekends to enjoy rural life, and only return to the city at dusk.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的小學教導孩子從平常生活中學習遵守規定。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de xiǎoxué jiàodǎo háizi cóng píngcháng shēnghuó zhōng xuéxí zūnshǒu guīdìng.
examples.english: Elementary schools in Taiwan teach children to learn to comply with rules in their daily lives.

examples.chinese: 現代人生活忙碌，就算是好友也偶然才碰面聊聊。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén shēnghuó mánglù, jiùsuàn shì hǎoyǒu yě ǒurán cái pèngmiàn liáoliao.
examples.english: Modern people are busy with life; even good friends only meet occasionally to chat.

items.wordHook: Being born (生) and existing (活) is life.

examples.chinese: 週末到花蓮的火車票一下子就賣光了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò dào Huālián de huǒchēpiào yīxiàzi jiù mài guāng le.
examples.english: Weekend train tickets to Hualien sold out in an instant.

examples.chinese: 剩下的飯菜加熱太多次，就沒什麼營養了，最好每餐都吃光。
examples.pinyin: Shèngxià de fàncài jiārè tài duō cì, jiù méi shénme yíngyǎng le, zuìhǎo měi cān dōu chī guāng.
examples.english: If leftover food is heated too many times, it loses its nutrition; it's best to finish it all at each meal.

examples.chinese:
包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。
妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
examples.pinyin:
Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo.
Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.
examples.english:
Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best.
Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one.

examples.chinese: 強烈的陽光對我們的眼睛不好，出門活動時最好戴上太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè de yángguāng duì wǒmen de yǎnjing bù hǎo, chūmén huódòng shí zuìhǎo dài shàng tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: Strong sunlight is bad for our eyes; when going out for activities, it's best to wear sunglasses.

examples.chinese:
我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。
那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne.
Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english:
When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought.
That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese:
每年農曆一月初一是華人新年的第一天。
我父母每個月初寄錢給我，但我總是在月中就把錢花光了。
examples.pinyin:
Měi nián nónglì yī yuè chū yī shì Huárén xīnnián de dì yī tiān.
Wǒ fùmǔ měi ge yuè chū jì qián gěi wǒ, dàn wǒ zǒngshì zài yuè zhōng jiù bǎ qián huā guāng le.
examples.english:
The first day of the first lunar month each year is the first day of the Chinese New Year.
My parents send me money at the beginning of every month, but I always spend it all by the middle of the month.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten.

examples.chinese: 王先生投資生意的眼光很好，讓他僅僅一年就買下了好幾棟大樓。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng tóuzī shēngyì de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, ràng tā jǐnjǐn yī nián jiù mǎi xià le hǎo jǐ dòng dàlóu.
examples.english: Mr. Wang's eye for investing in business is very good; it made him buy several buildings in just one year.

examples.chinese: 元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.
examples.english: During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 他愛亂花錢，三天下來，就把一個月的生活費花光了。
examples.pinyin: Tā ài luàn huā qián, sān tiān xiàlái, jiù bǎ yí ge yuè de shēnghuófèi huā guāng le.
examples.english: He loves to spend money recklessly; over three days, he spent his whole month's living expenses.

examples.chinese: 在冬天，臺灣南部比北部暖和，你可以到南部享受暖暖的陽光。
examples.pinyin: Zài dōngtiān, Táiwān nánbù bǐ běibù nuǎnhuo, nǐ kěyǐ dào nánbù xiǎngshòu nuǎnnuǎn de yángguāng.
examples.english: In winter, southern Taiwan is warmer than the north; you can go to the south to enjoy the warm sunshine.

examples.chinese: 假如缺乏陽光、空氣和水這三項條件，植物就無法生長。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú quēfá yángguāng, kōngqì hé shuǐ zhè sān xiàng tiáojiàn, zhíwù jiù wúfǎ shēngzhǎng.
examples.english: If plants lack the three conditions of sunlight, air, and water, they cannot grow.

examples.chinese: 我昨天割草時沒戴帽子，整張臉都因為陽光太強而變紅了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gē cǎo shí méi dài màozi, zhěng zhāng liǎn dōu yīnwèi yángguāng tài qiáng ér biàn hóng le.
examples.english: When I mowed the lawn yesterday, I didn't wear a hat, and my whole face turned red because the sunlight was too strong.

examples.chinese: 一個國家光是依靠免費簽證，是無法吸引國外遊客來旅行的。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè guójiā guāng shì yīkào miǎnfèi qiānzhèng, shì wúfǎ xīyǐn guówài yóukè lái lǚxíng de.
examples.english: A country solely relying on free visas is unable to attract foreign tourists to travel.

examples.chinese: 上課光聽老師教是沒用的，還要親自練習幾遍。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè guāng tīng lǎoshī jiāo shì méiyòng de, hái yào qīnzì liànxí jǐ biàn.
examples.english: In class, merely listening to the teacher teach is useless; you also need to practice it yourself several times.

examples.chinese: 台灣有句著名的廣告台詞「心動不如馬上行動」，意思是當個人有了想法之後，光是想是沒用的，得立刻行動才行。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu jù zhùmíng de guǎnggào táicí “xīndòng bùrú mǎshàng xíngdòng”, yìsi shì dāng gèrén yǒu le xiǎngfǎ zhīhòu, guāng shì xiǎng shì méiyòng de, děi lìkè xíngdòng cái xíng.
examples.english: Taiwan has a famous advertising slogan, “Acting immediately is better than just being moved.” It means that after a person has an idea, merely thinking about it is useless; one must take action immediately.

examples.chinese: 夏天一到，就有不少遊客到海灘，光著身體享受陽光與海風。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān yí dào, jiù yǒu bùshǎo yóukè dào hǎitān, guāngzhe shēntǐ xiǎngshòu yángguāng yǔ hǎifēng.
examples.english: As soon as summer arrives, many tourists go to the beach, baring their bodies and enjoying the sunshine and sea breeze.

examples.chinese: 這種巧克力是情人節最熱門的商品，總是一下子就賣光了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qiǎokèlì shì Qíngrénjié zuì rèmén de shāngpǐn, zǒngshì yīxiàzi jiù mài guāng le.
examples.english: This kind of chocolate is the most popular product for Valentine's Day; it always sells out in no time.

examples.chinese: 這個城市夜晚因各種各樣的彩色燈光，而使得景色既浪漫又迷人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yèwǎn yīn gè zhǒng gè yàng de cǎisè dēngguāng, ér shǐde jǐngsè jì làngmàn yòu mírén.
examples.english: At night, this city, because of various colorful lights, makes the scenery both romantic and charming.

examples.chinese: 白天沙漠裡的沙子很燙(to be scalded)，要是光著腳，一定會被燙傷的。
examples.pinyin: Báitiān shāmò lǐ de shāzi hěn tàng, yàoshi guāngzhe jiǎo, yídìng huì bèi tàngshāng de.
examples.english: During the day, the sand in the desert is very hot; if you go barefoot, you will definitely get burned.

examples.chinese: 我去英國留學時，常利用週末到旅行社打工，帶觀光客到著名的景點觀光。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Yīngguó liúxué shí, cháng lìyòng zhōumò dào lǚxíngshè dǎgōng, dài guānguāngkè dào zhùmíng de jǐngdiǎn guānguāng.
examples.english: When I studied abroad in the UK, I often used weekends to work part-time at a travel agency, taking tourists sightseeing to famous attractions.

examples.chinese: 觀光客都說日本四季的景色都很有特色，有機會我要親自去體驗一下。
examples.pinyin: Guānguāngkè dōu shuō Rìběn sìjì de jǐngsè dōu hěn yǒu tèsè, yǒu jīhuì wǒ yào qīnzì qù tǐyàn yíxià.
examples.english: Tourists all say that Japan's scenery in all four seasons is very distinctive; if I have the chance, I want to experience it for myself.

examples.chinese: 每天光說夢想，一點兒用都沒有，還是努力實現比較實在。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān guāng shuō mèngxiǎng, yìdiǎnr yòng dōu méiyǒu, háishì nǔlì shíxiàn bǐjiào shízài.
examples.english: Just talking about dreams every day is of no use at all; it's more practical to work hard to achieve them.

examples.chinese: 有些國家為了吸引更多的觀光客來旅遊，就把一些出境、入境的手續改簡單了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā wèi le xīyǐn gèng duō de guānguāngkè lái lǚyóu, jiù bǎ yìxiē chūjìng, rùjìng de shǒuxù gǎi jiǎndān le.
examples.english: Some countries, in order to attract more tourists to travel, have simplified some exit and entry procedures.

examples.chinese: 在天氣好的夜晚，星光看起來更加浪漫。
examples.pinyin: Zài tiānqì hǎo de yèwǎn, xīngguāng kàn qǐlái gèngjiā làngmàn.
examples.english: On nights with good weather, the starlight looks even more romantic.

examples.chinese: 本地社區的房子常被好奇的觀光客破壞，令人們十分不滿。
examples.pinyin: Běndì shèqū de fángzi cháng bèi hàoqí de guānguāngkè pòhuài, lìng rénmen shífēn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Houses in the local community are often damaged by curious tourists, which makes people very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 花蓮太魯閣的確很漂亮，難怪每年都吸引許多觀光客去參觀。
examples.pinyin: Huālián Tàilǔgé dequè hěn piàoliang, nánguài měinián dōu xīyǐn xǔduō guānguāngkè qù cānguān.
examples.english: Hualien's Taroko Gorge is indeed very beautiful; no wonder it attracts many tourists to visit every year.

examples.chinese: 有些國家的傳統戲劇常利用影子和燈光效果來表演。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā de chuántǒng xìjù cháng lìyòng yǐngzi hé dēngguāng xiàoguǒ lái biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: Traditional theater in some countries often uses shadows and lighting effects to perform.

examples.chinese: 今天光是整理前院的花草樹木就讓我累得要命，只好明天再整理後院了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān guāng shì zhěnglǐ qiányuàn de huācǎo shùmù jiù ràng wǒ lèi de yàomìng, zhǐhǎo míngtiān zài zhěnglǐ hòuyuàn le.
examples.english: Today, just tidying up the flowers, plants, and trees in the front yard made me extremely tired, so I'll have to do the backyard tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 最近賣的新飲料很有特色，所以光臨我們店的客人越來越多。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn mài de xīn yǐnliào hěn yǒu tèsè, suǒyǐ guānglín wǒmen diàn de kèrén yuè lái yuè duō.
examples.english: The new drinks sold recently are very distinctive, so more and more customers are honoring our shop with their presence.

examples.chinese: 錢小姐戴的那副耳環就像星光一樣美麗，聽說那是祖母留給她的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Qián xiǎojiě dài de nà fù ěrhuán jiù xiàng xīngguāng yīyàng měilì, tīngshuō nà shì zǔmǔ liú gěi tā de huíyì.
examples.english: That pair of earrings Miss Qian is wearing is as beautiful as starlight; I heard that they are a memory her grandmother left to her.

examples.chinese: 有些事情光是勤勞沒有用，得用對方法才行。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shìqíng guāng shì qínláo méiyǒu yòng, děi yòng duì fāngfǎ cái xíng.
examples.english: For some things, just being hardworking is not useful; you have to use the right method.

examples.chinese: 為了發展工業而不斷開發，這樣下去森林早晚會被破壞光的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fāzhǎn gōngyè ér bùduàn kāifā, zhèyàng xiàqù sēnlín zǎowǎn huì bèi pòhuài guāng de.
examples.english: Developing industry by constantly exploiting resources, if this continues, the forests will sooner or later be completely destroyed.

examples.chinese: 他勸我別太在意別人的眼光，把自己負責的事完成就好。
examples.pinyin: Tā quàn wǒ bié tài zàiyì biérén de yǎnguāng, bǎ zìjǐ fùzé de shì wánchéng jiù hǎo.
examples.english: He advised me not to care too much about others' opinions, and to just complete the things I am responsible for.

examples.chinese: 在戶外的夜景中攝影，以月光當作背景可增加神秘的感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zài hùwài de yèjǐng zhōng shèyǐng, yǐ yuèguāng dāngzuò bèijǐng kě zēngjiā shénmì de gǎnjué.
examples.english: When photographing outdoor night scenes, using moonlight as the background can add a mysterious feeling.

examples.chinese: 在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
examples.pinyin: Zài guānguāng jǐngdiǎn xiāoshòu jìniànpǐn, jiàgé tōngcháng bǐ yībān shāngdiàn gāo yīxiē.
examples.english: Souvenirs sold at tourist attractions are usually a bit more expensive than those in regular stores.

examples.chinese: 史小姐到花蓮來觀光時不小心迷了路，幸虧遇到了熱心的阿姨送她回旅館。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě dào Huālián lái guānguāng shí bù xiǎoxīn mí le lù, xìngkuī yùdào le rèxīn de āyí sòng tā huí lǚguǎn.
examples.english: When Miss Shi came to Hualien for sightseeing, she accidentally got lost; fortunately, she met a warmhearted auntie who took her back to the hotel.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生對客人很親切，讓客人都吃得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng duì kèrén hěn qīnqiè, ràng kèrén dōu chī de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very kind to the customers, which makes the customers all eat happily.

examples.chinese: 那位服務生不笑的時候，樣子看起來很兇，其實他對客人的態度很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúwùshēng bù xiào de shíhou, yàngzi kàn qǐlái hěn xiōng, qíshí tā duì kèrén de tàidù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: When that waiter doesn't smile, he looks very fierce, but actually his attitude toward customers is very good.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很貼心，只要客人一上門，立刻提供面紙給客人擦手。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn tiēxīn, zhǐyào kèrén yī shàngmén, lìkè tígōng miànzhǐ gěi kèrén cā shǒu.
examples.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very considerate; as soon as customers come in, they immediately provide tissues for them to wipe their hands.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很厲害，一隻手能端好幾個盤子。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn lìhài, yī zhī shǒu néng duān hǎo jǐ gè pánzi.
examples.english: The waiter at that restaurant is very impressive; he can hold several plates level with one hand.

examples.chinese: 行動不方便的乘客乘車時，車站有服務員為他們服務。
examples.pinyin: Xíngdòng bù fāngbiàn de chéngkè chéngchē shí, chēzhàn yǒu fúwùyuán wèi tāmen fúwù.
examples.english: When passengers with limited mobility ride the train, there are service staff at the station to serve them.

examples.chinese: 華語文中心的學生邀請台灣朋友來參加世界文化日的活動。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔwén zhōngxīn de xuésheng yāoqǐng Táiwān péngyou lái cānjiā shìjiè wénhuà rì de huódòng.
examples.english: The students at the Mandarin Learning Center invited Taiwanese friends to come participate in the World Culture Day activities.

examples.chinese: 學校邀請李教授來演講，內容相當精彩，讓我有很大的收穫。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào yāoqǐng Lǐ jiàoshòu lái yǎnjiǎng, nèiróng xiāngdāng jīngcǎi, ràng wǒ yǒu hěn dà de shōuhuò.
examples.english: The school invited Professor Li to give a lecture; the content was quite wonderful, which gave me a great harvest.

examples.chinese: 你帶著邀請卡給門口的服務人員檢查，才能入場參加活動。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dài zhe yāoqǐngkǎ gěi ménkǒu de fúwù rényuán jiǎnchá, cái néng rùchǎng cānjiā huódòng.
examples.english: You bring your invitation card for the service staff at the entrance to check, and only then can you enter the venue to participate in the event.

examples.chinese: 我通常在家吃晚餐，只有好朋友邀請我吃飯，才會出門。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tōngcháng zài jiā chī wǎncān, zhǐyǒu hǎo péngyǒu yāoqǐng wǒ chīfàn, cái huì chūmén.
examples.english: I usually eat dinner at home; only when a good friend invites me to eat do I go out.

examples.chinese: 這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòtánhuì yāoqǐng le gè lǐngyù de rénmen, zhǔyào mùdì shì duì guónèi de dìfāng jiànshè tí yìxiē jiànyì.
examples.english: This forum invited people from various fields; its main purpose is to offer some suggestions for domestic local construction.

examples.chinese: 手機廠商時常邀請明星替他們的產品宣傳。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī chǎngshāng shícháng yāoqǐng míngxīng tì tāmen de chǎnpǐn xuānchuán.
examples.english: Mobile phone manufacturers often invite celebrities to promote their products.

examples.chinese: 我與高中同學已十多年沒見了，想找個適當時間邀請大家聚聚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǔ gāozhōng tóngxué yǐ shí duō nián méi jiàn le, xiǎng zhǎo ge shìdàng shíjiān yāoqǐng dàjiā jù ju.
examples.english: I haven't seen my high school classmates for over ten years; I want to find an appropriate time to invite everyone to get together.

examples.chinese: 在全球環境會議中，聯合國邀請了一些環保團體共同參與。
examples.pinyin: Zài quánqiú huánjìng huìyì zhōng, Liánhéguó yāoqǐng le yìxiē huánbǎo tuántǐ gòngtóng cānyù.
examples.english: At the global environmental conference, the United Nations invited some environmental groups to participate together.

examples.chinese: 華人喜歡像二、六、八的數字，這幾個數字都是雙數，有很多好事一起來的意思。
examples.pinyin: Huárén xǐhuān xiàng èr, liù, bā de shùzì, zhè jǐ ge shùzì dōu shì shuāngshù, yǒu hěn duō hǎoshì yìqǐ lái de yìsi.
examples.english: Chinese people like numbers like two, six, and eight; these numbers are all even numbers, which means many good things come together.

examples.chinese: 從明天起天氣會變冷，溫度會比今天降低五度，出門時最好穿上外套。
examples.pinyin: Cóng míngtiān qǐ tiānqì huì biàn lěng, wēndù huì bǐ jīntiān jiàngdī wǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo chuān shàng wàitào.
examples.english: Starting tomorrow, the weather will turn cold; the temperature will drop five degrees compared to today, so it's best to put on a jacket when going out.

examples.chinese: 國內幾家銀行決定從明年起，降低跨行匯款的手續費。
examples.pinyin: Guónèi jǐ jiā yínháng juédìng cóng míngnián qǐ, jiàngdī kuàháng huìkuǎn de shǒuxùfèi.
examples.english: Several domestic banks have decided that starting next year, they will lower the service fees for interbank remittances.

examples.chinese: 水災過後應立刻打掃環境，才能降低傳染病流行的機會。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐzāi guòhòu yīng lìkè dǎsǎo huánjìng, cái néng jiàngdī chuánrǎnbìng liúxíng de jīhuì.
examples.english: After a flood, one should immediately clean up the environment; only then can the chance of infectious diseases spreading be reduced.

examples.chinese: 對學生來說，經常失眠可能降低學習效率。
examples.pinyin: Duì xuéshēng lái shuō, jīngcháng shīmián kěnéng jiàngdī xuéxí xiàolǜ.
examples.english: For students, frequent insomnia may reduce learning efficiency.

items.wordHook: Combining 降(descend) and 低(low): 降低 means lower.

examples.chinese: 那個明星對穿著很講究，總是花很多時間，研究什麼上衣配什麼長褲才好看。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng duì chuānzhuó hěn jiǎngjiū, zǒngshì huā hěn duō shíjiān, yánjiū shénme shàngyī pèi shénme chángkù cái hǎokàn.
examples.english: That star is very particular about apparel, always spending a lot of time researching what top goes with what pants to look good.

examples.chinese: 東西方的文化差異很大，像穿著、音樂、哲學等風格都不相同。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxīfāng de wénhuà chāyì hěn dà, xiàng chuānzhuó, yīnyuè, zhéxué děng fēnggé dōu bù xiāngtóng.
examples.english: The cultural differences between East and West are great; styles such as apparel, music, and philosophy are all different.

examples.chinese: 你在名牌服裝的專櫃工作，我想聽聽看你對穿著和品味的看法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài míngpái fúzhuāng de zhuānguì gōngzuò, wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng kàn nǐ duì chuānzhuó hé pǐnwèi de kànfǎ.
examples.english: You work at a designer clothing counter; I'd like to hear your opinion on dressing and taste.

examples.chinese: 小何穿著綠色牛仔褲、紅襯衫，再戴上藍色的帽子，我覺得這些顏色配在一起很醜。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hé chuānzhe lǜsè niúzǎikù, hóng chènshān, zài dài shàng lánsè de màozi, wǒ juéde zhèxiē yánsè pèi zài yīqǐ hěn chǒu.
examples.english: Xiǎo Hé is wearing green jeans, a red shirt, and then puts on a blue hat; I think these colors paired together are very ugly.

examples.chinese: 白小姐平時對穿著不怎麼講究，衣服穿來穿去總是那幾件。
examples.pinyin: Bái xiǎojiě píngshí duì chuānzhuó bù zěnme jiǎngjiu, yīfu chuān lái chuān qù zǒngshì nà jǐ jiàn.
examples.english: Miss Bai doesn't pay much attention to clothing in normal times; the clothes she wears are always just those few pieces.

examples.chinese: 小張不僅長得帥，穿著也很有品味，所以很多人都以為他是明星。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng bùjǐn zhǎng de shuài, chuānzhuó yě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi tā shì míngxīng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Zhāng is not only handsome but also dresses with great taste, so many people think he is a celebrity.

examples.chinese: 我認為多看時尚雜誌、多看模特兒怎麼穿衣服，應該就能使自己的穿著更有品味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi duō kàn shíshàng zázhì, duō kàn mótè'er zěnme chuān yīfu, yīnggāi jiù néng shǐ zìjǐ de chuānzhuó gèng yǒu pǐnwèi.
examples.english: I think that by reading more fashion magazines and looking more at how models wear clothes, you should be able to make your own clothing more tasteful.

examples.chinese: 童先生穿著一件綠色的襯衫，配上一條咖啡色的褲子，看起來真像一棵樹。
examples.pinyin: Tóng xiānsheng chuānzhe yī jiàn lǜsè de chènshān, pèi shàng yī tiáo kāfēisè de kùzi, kàn qǐlái zhēn xiàng yī kē shù.
examples.english: Mr. Tong is wearing a green shirt, matched with a brown pair of pants; he really looks like a tree.

examples.chinese: 王小姐跟男朋友約會的時候，都穿著很漂亮的衣服。今天晚上哥哥跟女朋友有個約會。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě gēn nánpéngyou yuēhuì de shíhou, dōu chuānzhe hěn piàoliang de yīfu. Jīntiān wǎnshang gēge gēn nǚpéngyou yǒu ge yuēhuì.
examples.english: When Miss Wang goes on a date with her boyfriend, she always wears very pretty clothes. Tonight my older brother has a date with his girlfriend.

examples.chinese: 電影明星一向很重視自己的穿著，合適的穿著才能讓他們更有品味、更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng míngxīng yīxiàng hěn zhòngshì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó, héshì de chuānzhuó cái néng ràng tāmen gèng yǒu pǐnwèi, gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Movie stars have always attached great importance to their clothing; only suitable clothing can make them have more taste and more confidence.

examples.chinese: 你最好別穿著拖鞋去參加正式活動，要不然別人可能認為你不懂禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo bié chuān zhe tuōxié qù cānjiā zhèngshì huódòng, yàobùrán biérén kěnéng rènwéi nǐ bù dǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: You'd better not wear slippers to attend a formal event, otherwise others might think you don't understand manners.

examples.chinese: 天氣這麼熱，你居然穿著一件大外套，不覺得不舒服嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì zhème rè, nǐ jūrán chuānzhe yī jiàn dà wàitào, bù juéde bù shūfu ma?
examples.english: The weather is so hot, yet you unexpectedly are wearing a big coat—don't you feel uncomfortable?

examples.chinese: 市長解決了不少這個城市的生活問題，因此民眾的生活水準也大大提高了。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng jiějué le bùshǎo zhège chéngshì de shēnghuó wèntí, yīncǐ mínzhòng de shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě dàdà tígāo le.
examples.english: The mayor solved quite a few of this city's living problems, therefore the people's standard of living has also greatly improved.

examples.chinese:
張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。
姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin:
Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le.
Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english:
Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard.
Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese:
科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。
網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin:
Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí.
Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english:
Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life.
The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

items.wordHook: Repeating 大(big) twice for emphasis: 大大 means greatly.

examples.chinese: 小張的個性比較懶，很少主動幫同事的忙。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng de gèxìng bǐjiào lǎn, hěn shǎo zhǔdòng bāng tóngshì de máng.
examples.english: Little Zhang's personality is rather lazy; he rarely takes the initiative to help his colleagues.

examples.chinese: 參加旅行團或自助旅遊各有各的優點，懶得自己安排行程的人，就跟著導遊走吧。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lǚxíngtuán huò zìzhù lǚyóu gè yǒu gè de yōudiǎn, lǎn de zìjǐ ānpái xíngchéng de rén, jiù gēnzhe dǎoyóu zǒu ba.
examples.english: Joining a tour group or traveling independently each has its own advantages; those who are too lazy to arrange their own itinerary should just follow the tour guide.

examples.chinese: 他對人很不客氣，因此大家都懶得理他。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì rén hěn bù kèqi, yīncǐ dàjiā dōu lǎn de lǐ tā.
examples.english: He is very impolite to people, so everyone cannot be bothered to pay attention to him.

examples.chinese: 中國人看傳統戲劇時都喜歡準備一盤瓜子，邊吃邊欣賞。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguórén kàn chuántǒng xìjù shí dōu xǐhuān zhǔnbèi yī pán guāzǐ, biān chī biān xīnshǎng.
examples.english: When Chinese people watch traditional opera, they all like to prepare a plate of melon seeds and enjoy them while watching.

examples.chinese: 登山的時候得注意安全，事前多準備，才能享受登山的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Dēngshān de shíhou děi zhùyì ānquán, shìqián duō zhǔnbèi, cái néng xiǎngshòu dēngshān de lèqù.
examples.english: When climbing a mountain, you must pay attention to safety; prepare more beforehand so you can enjoy the fun of mountain climbing.

examples.chinese: 我去澳洲登山時，碰見了正在自助旅行的老朋友，真巧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Àozhōu dēngshān shí, pèngjiàn le zhèngzài zìzhù lǚxíng de lǎo péngyou, zhēn qiǎo!
examples.english: When I went mountain climbing in Australia, I ran into an old friend who was traveling independently—what a coincidence!

examples.chinese: 這班飛機因為天氣不穩定，所以誤點了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì bù wěndìng, suǒyǐ wùdiǎn le.
examples.english: This flight was behind schedule because the weather was unstable.

items.wordHook: To 吃(eat) a 苦(bitter): 吃苦 means endure hardship and suffering.
A grant of royal 幸(favor) stamped with a 卩(seal) is carried out 又(again) to proudly 報(announce) good news.
a 京(capital) gate opens with 尤(yóu) flair → and 就(then) we enter.
Combining 房(building) and 客(guest): 房客 means tenant.
a 言(speech) at 午(noon) seals a deal → 許(consent).
a 辶(movement) takes a 周(zhōu) turn → one full 週(week) done.
